title: Quakertown Oral History Project
creator: University of North Texas Oral History Program
archive: University of North Texas Oral History Program
citation: University of North Texas Oral History Program, Quakertown Oral History Project.
notes: Project overview describing Quakertown, its removal in the 1920s, and oral histories focused on family history, the move, and community ties.

title: OH 1642: Reginald Logan
creator: Sherelyn Yancey
archive: University of North Texas Oral History Program
citation: Reginald Logan, interview by Sherelyn Yancey, November 28, 2006, OH 1642, University of North Texas Oral History Program.
notes: Interview with a descendant of Quakertown homeowners discussing his father John Logan, other relatives, forced relocation, segregated schools, and family memory of Quakertown.

title: OH 1212: Frederick Douglass Moore Family
creator: Adelene Martin
archive: University of North Texas Oral History Program
citation: Frederick Douglass Moore family, interview by Adelene Martin, May 12, 1986, OH 1212, University of North Texas Oral History Program.
notes: Interview includes memories of Quakertown, Fred Moore, Frederick Douglass Colored School, and the removal of African American residents to southeast Denton.

title: The Woods House
creator: Denton County Office of History and Culture
citation: Denton County Office of History and Culture, Current Projects: The Woods House.
notes: County history describing William Evelyn Woods, Alberta Woods, their Quakertown property, and their relocation to Solomon Hill.

title: Quakertown: An Undertold Story
creator: Denton County Historical Commission
citation: Denton County Historical Commission, Quakertown: An Undertold Story.
notes: Historical narrative documenting Quakertown and the original Fred Douglass School at the corner of Terry and Holt Streets.

title: Maude Woods Clark Hembry House
creator: University of North Texas Libraries
citation: Maude Woods Clark Hembry House, photograph and descriptive record, University of North Texas Libraries, The Portal to Texas History.
notes: Documents a house built in 1905 at 97 Terry Street in Quakertown and relocated in 1921 to 1129 East Hickory Street in Solomon Hill.
